name: Dr. Anas Al-Nuaimi
headline: Data Architect for Machine Learning and AI at BMW Autonomous Driving | TUM | CDTM
summary:
Dr of Engineering (Dr.-Ing.) Computer Vision and Master's degree in communications engineering and hons degree in technology management from CDTM (www.cdtm.de).

8 years experience in SW engineering for autonomous driving at BMW filling the roles of Senior SW Eng, Data Engineer and Data Architect as well as the Lead for the AI/ML Community for Autonomous Driving.

Extensive research and development experience incl. years as research associate at the Chair of Media Technology of the Department of Electrical and Computer Eng. of TUM.

Extensive programming experience in the following languages Python, C++, Scala.

Topics in which I have experience:
-3D Computer Vision (content-based image retrieval, 3D mapping, 3D mapping and reconstruction, etc.)
-Machine learning
-Navigation and sensor fusion
-Video processing

positions.title: Data Architect
positions.description:
- Design and architecture of ETL Data pipelines
- Project management of migration of ETL data pipelines from on-prem to AWS cloud impacting multiple teams
- Development of an MLOps data lifecycle tracker
- Community lead for AI/ML Community of Autonomous Driving

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer for Computer Vision
positions.description:
Leadership:
- Led the drafting of the ML-specific part for an RfP for cloud service provisioning
- Led the evaluation of the offerings of major cloud providers from ML perspective in coordination with stakeholders
- Facilitator of the AI/ML community

Software Engineering
- [Data Engineering] Built and maintained data pipelines running on an on-prem cloud (Airflow, Python, Kubernetes, C++, Docker)
- [MLOps] Built a database-based data lifecycle tracker (Postgres, Kubernetes, SQLAlchemy)
- [MLOps] Integrated the ML model training with an experiment tracker running on the on-prem cloud using Kubernetes (Postgres, MLFlow)

positions.title: Software Engineer for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
positions.description:
Software Engineering:
- Developed an embedded predictor launched in the BMW 7 Series
- Wrote code for applications running on an on-prem cloud for Big Data processing of test car fleet data (Apache Spark, Scala, Python, Bazel, Zuul CI, Airflow)
- Built a framework for product-grade Machine Learning (MLOps)

Steering & Project Management:
- Supervised two external software partner teams in the area of Data Engineering and Machine Learning
- Shaped the milestone plans and item backlog

Leadership:
- As facilitator of the AI/ML Community organized meetups and reported to management
- Coordinated evaluations of startup offerings

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
Research:
-3D mapping of indoor spaces using 3D LIDAR (specifically LIDAR scan matching).
-3D scanning and reconstruction of objects using Lidar and Time-of-Flight sensors (Kinect).
-Content-based Image Retrieval (with Docomo Eurolabs).
-Outdoor navigation using sensor fusion of GPS and IMU and Kalman filtering (with Docomo Eurolabs).
-Image and video processing.

Fund acquisition: 
Wrote multiple research proposals and successfully acquired funds for the institute. 

Supervision: 
Supervised >20 bachelor's and master's thesis as well as interns.

Teaching: 
Developed and taught a lab on designing and programming Augemented Reality (AR) computer games.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Conducted an internship on the topic of H.264 rate adaptation through transcoding and layer dropping.
Had to deal extensively with the technical standard and included implementation and testing in Matlab.

-Classifying the patents in predefined categories.

company.name: BMW Group
company.tagline: We make individual mobility more human, more intelligent and more responsible.
company.description:
With its four brands, BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad, the BMW Group is the world’s leading premium manufacturer of automobiles and motorcycles and also provides premium financial services. The BMW Group production network comprises over 30 production sites worldwide; the company has a global sales network in more than 140 countries.

In 2025, the BMW Group sold 2.46 million passenger vehicles and more than 202,500 motorcycles worldwide. The profit before tax in the financial year 2025 was € 10.2 billion on revenues amounting to € 133,5 billion. As of 31 December 2025, the BMW Group had a workforce of 154,540 employees.

The economic success of the BMW Group has always been based on long-term thinking and respon-sible action. Sustainability is a key element of the BMW Group’s corporate strategy and covers all products – from the supply chain through production to the end of their useful life.
